name: Sugar No. 11
read: Sugar No. 11 Mar 27 options (on MAR 27 futures 18.24, 102 days to expiry 2027-02-16): at-the-money implied vol 26.2%, -0.4 pts vs 2026-10-30. 20-day realized vol 28.2%, so options trade at a discount of 2.0 pts. 25-delta risk reversal +5.0 (calls over puts). Over the last 10 sessions (2026-10-26 to 2026-11-06) call open interest rose 45,036 and puts rose 25,340; put/call OI 0.52 → 0.52, front futures 19.1 → 18.24. Delta-weighted, option holders added about +7,554 futures-equivalent lots in the last 5 sessions (net long exposure bought through options). Front ATM vol 25.9% → 24.9%. Largest Mar 27 strikes: 21 calls (24,465 lots) and 17 puts (18,747). Biggest 5-session builds: Jan 27 18.5 puts +2,565; Oct 27 40 calls +2,315. Biggest cut: Mar 27 18 puts -1,024.
